content: मुच् I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (मोचते) To deceive, cheat; see मुञ्च्. --II. €6 <ab>U.</ab> (मुञ्चति-ते, मुमोच-मुमुचे, अमुचत्-अमुक्त, मोक्ष्यति-ते, मोक्तुम्, मुक्त) .²1 To loose, set free, release, let go, let loose, liberate, deliver (from captivity <ab>&c.</ab>); वनाय … यशोधनो धेनुमृषेर्मुमोच <ls>R. 2. 1</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 20</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 202</ls>; मोक्ष्यते सुरबन्दीनां वेणीर्वीर्यविभूतिभिः <ls>Ku. 2. 61</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 47</ls>; मा भवानङ्गानि मुञ्चतु <ls>V. 2</ls> ‘let not thy limbs droop’, ‘do not despond’. .²2 To set free, loosen (as the voice); कण्ठं मुञ्चति बर्हिणः समदनः <ls>Mk. 5. 14</ls> ‘loosens his throat or voice’ {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} raises a cry. .²3 To leave, abandon, quit, give up, lay aside, relinquish; रात्रिर्गता मतिमतां वर मुञ्च शग्याम् <ls>R. 5. 66</ls>; मुञ्च मयि मानमनिदानम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>; मुनिसुताप्रणयस्मृतिरोधिना मम च मुक्तमिदं तमसा मनः <ls>Ś. 6. 7</ls>; मौनं मुञ्चति किं च कैरवकुले <ls>Bv. 1. 4</ls>; आविर्भूते शशिनि तमसा मुच्यमानेव रात्रिः <ls>V. 1. 8</ls>; <ls>Me. 41</ls>, <ls n="Me.">96</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 11</ls>. .²4 To set apart, take away, except. See मुक्त्वा. .²5 To dismiss, send away. .²6 To cast, throw, hurl, fling, discharge; मृगेषु शरान् मुमुक्षोः <ls>R. 9. 58</ls>; <ls>Bk. 15. 53</ls>. .²7 To emit, drop, pour forth or down, shed, let fall (tears <ab>&c.</ab>); अपसृतपाण्डुपत्रा मुञ्चन्त्यश्रूणीव लताः <ls>Ś. 4. 12</ls>; चिरविरहजं मुञ्चतो बाष्पमुष्णम् <ls>Me. 12</ls>; स शरवृष्टिमुचा धनुषा <ls>R. 9. 12</ls>; <ls>Bk. 7. 2</ls>. .²8 To utter, give forth; मदमुखरमयूरीमुक्तसंसक्तकेकाः <ls>Māl. 9. 5</ls>; <ls>Bk. 7. 57</ls>. .²9 To give away, grant, bestow. .²10 To put on (<ab>Ā.</ab>). .²11 To void (as excrement). .²12 To sacrifice. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} (मुच्यते) .²1 To be loosed or released, be freed or absolved from (with <ab>abl.</ab> or <ab>instr.</ab>); मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To become loose or relaxed. .²3 To free oneself, escape. .²4 To abandon, deviate or swerve from. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (मोचयति-ते) .²1 To cause to be freed or liberated. .²2 To cause to shed. .²3 To loose, set at liberty, liberate. .²4 To extricate, disentangle. .²5 To unyoke, unharness. .²6 To give away, bestow. .²7 To gladden, delight. .²8 To open (a road). .²9 To redeem from. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (मुमुक्षति) .²1 To wish to free or liberate <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 (मुमुक्षते, मोक्षते) To long for final emancipation.
मुच् {%a.%} (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Freeing, liberating, delivering from. .²2 Discharging, throwing, sending, emitting. .²3 Giving up, leaving <ab>&c.</ab>
